hero.subhead: Vero Beach Adult Medicine is adult primary care from Dr. Patricia Stewart, a board-certified internal medicine physician. We're accepting new patients.

role.heading: One doctor for
role.body1: A primary care doctor is the physician you see first and keep seeing: for yearly checkups, for ongoing conditions like blood pressure and diabetes, and for the day you wake up sick. Primary care physician, PCP, and personal doctor all describe that same role.
role.body2: Here, that doctor is Dr. Patricia Stewart. Visits are built around real time with your doctor, and a new patient's first appointment is longer than a standard visit so she can understand your full health picture, not just check a box.

nearYou.heading: Find us at Citrus
nearYou.body: If you're searching for a primary care doctor near you in Vero Beach, we're at 955 37th Place, Vero Beach, FL 32960. Call us, text our office, or register online and we'll take it from there.

insurance.heading: Will my insurance
insurance.body: We accept most major plans, including Florida Blue, United Healthcare, Cigna, Aetna, Humana, and Medicare. Self-pay is also welcome. Call (772) 569-3212 and we'll verify your specific plan before your first visit.

faqs.q: Is Vero Beach Adult Medicine accepting new primary care patients?
faqs.a: Yes. Vero Beach Adult Medicine is accepting new adult patients. You can register online or call us at (772) 569-3212.

faqs.q: Who is the primary care doctor at Vero Beach Adult Medicine?
faqs.a: Dr. Patricia Stewart, a board-certified internal medicine physician with more than 25 years in private practice and particular expertise in women's health.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a primary care doctor, a primary care physician, and a PCP?
faqs.a: There is no difference. All three describe the physician you see for routine care, ongoing conditions, and sick visits. PCP is short for primary care physician.

faqs.q: Where can I find a primary care doctor near me in Vero Beach?
faqs.a: Vero Beach Adult Medicine is a primary care practice at Citrus Medical Plaza, 955 37th Place, Vero Beach, FL 32960, and we're accepting new adult patients. Call (772) 569-3212 or register online.

faqs.q: What does a primary care doctor here help with?
faqs.a: Annual physicals and wellness visits, ongoing care for conditions like blood pressure, diabetes, thyroid, and cholesterol, sick visits, women's and men's health, preventive screenings and labs, and practical guidance on sleep, weight, nutrition, and stress.

We accept most major plans, including Florida Blue, United Healthcare, Cigna, Aetna, Humana, and Medicare. Self-pay is also welcome. Call (772) 569-3212 and we'll verify your specific plan before your first visit.

faqs.q: Is there a membership fee to see a primary care doctor at Vero Beach Adult Medicine?
faqs.a: No. Vero Beach Adult Medicine has no membership fee. We accept most major insurance plans and welcome self-pay.

faqs.q: How do I book my first visit?
faqs.a: Start your new patient registration online, book an appointment through our scheduling page, or call (772) 569-3212. You can also text our office.

cta.heading: Ready when you are.
cta.subhead: Register online in a few minutes, book a time, or just call. Whichever is easiest for you.
